tide_key.name: Tide Key
tide_key.lore: Opens the sealed door to the Drowned Crown Basin.

tide_pearl.name: Tide Pearl
tide_pearl.lore: An offering for the basin in the Tidal Court.

mechanics.jam: The mechanism is jammed. The sluices open from the lowest lever upward.

onStep.text: Somewhere below, a heavy chain begins to turn.
The pool shudders. One lever remains.

onDone.text: The sluice gate unseals: a passage opens at the bottom of the well, leading to the Sunken Archive.
The floodgates drop. The canal drains and the tide will not return.

mechanics.hint: A basin of still water. It wants a pearl of the deep.
mechanics.verb: sets a pearl in the basin and the wall behind it slides away.

mechanics.hint: A sealed door of prismarine, a heart-shaped hollow in its centre.
mechanics.verb: sets the Tide Key in the door and it grinds open.

onOpen.text: The way to the Drowned Crown Basin is open.

waves.say: The pool ripples. Something answers the pearl.

onDone.text: The trial is passed. A pearl glimmers on the pedestal.

hazards.warning: The reservoir sluices groan: the tide is turning!

encounters.say: Three sluice levers climb the western gantry. Open them from the lowest, and the well will open.
Water seeps from the broken aqueduct, and things stir in the puddles.

bosses.name: The Tide Warden
bosses.intro: The basin stirs. Break the three wards on the crown pillars to wake what sleeps below.
bosses.deathText: The Tide Warden sinks. The basin goes still.

shield.breakText: The wards shatter! Strike the Warden now!
shield.relapseText: The wards reform and the tide calls its servants.

effects.text: The Warden stamps and the moat boils.

completion.intro: The Drowned Reservoir. Cross the canal, wake the sluices, and take the Tide Key.
completion.message: The reservoir drains. The dungeon closes shortly.
